remarks: Welcome to the Townhomes at the Metropolitan. Experience luxury living in this stunning 3-bedroom, 3.5-bath end-unit townhouse located in the heart of downtown Stamford. Spanning four beautifully finished levels, this home features gleaming hardwood floors and soaring 9+ ft ceilings throughout. The chef-inspired eat-in kitchen offers an ideal layout for cooking and entertaining, seamlessly flowing into a sunlit living room with direct access to a private balcony-perfect for morning coffee or evening relaxation. Upstairs, you'll find three spacious bedrooms, each with its own full bathroom, offering comfort and privacy for all. The finished lower level includes a versatile family room with sliders opening to a secluded patio, ideal for indoor-outdoor living. Additional highlights include a 2-car garage and generous storage space. Conveniently located near shops, restaurants, Metro-North, and all that Stamford has to offer, this home combines luxury, space, and convenience in one exceptional package.
